node.name: Team & Overview
node.rich_text: The Student Information System is a software application designed to manage student information efficiently. It provides a user interface for displaying and managing student records and uses a MySQL database to store and retrieve information. The system includes CRUD (Create, Read, Update, and Delete) operations, allowing users to add new student records, view existing information, edit records, and delete records when necessary.

UI Layout & DataGridView Display • Designs and arranges the application's user interface. • Organizes the layout of the forms and interface components. • Implements the display of student records using DataGridView.

MySQL Setup & Database Connection ◇ Sets up the MySQL database. ◇ Configures the database connection for the application. ◇ Ensures that the application can connect to and communicate with the database.

CRUD Logic (Add, Edit, Delete) ◇ Implements the logic for adding student records. ◇ Develops the functionality for editing existing student information. ◇ Implements the functionality for deleting student records.

Error Handling & CherryTree Documentation ◇ Implements error handling to manage application errors and unexpected inputs. ◇ Helps improve the application's reliability through error checking. ◇ Prepares and organizes the project documentation using CherryTree.

◇ Display student records in a DataGridView.
◇ Add new student information.
◇ Edit existing student records.
◇ Delete student records.
◇ Connect to a MySQL database.
◇ Handle errors during application operations.
